options.content: Adapted from grafana_dram.json. Backend-specific metrics appear only when the backend and operation are active. Current SGLang UCM integration selects the Posix pipeline. Missing series are not zero. Detailed rows retain per-worker values; original overview panels may aggregate selected workers. Posix byte/duration metrics can include failed tasks; health=1 is not a write-success counter.
